viewer: Cesium 1.145, headless Chrome software WebGL, isolated test scene
direction_source: SPICE spkcpo CN+S local east/north/up Sun directions; negated to light travel directions then rotated by the recorded local-to-Moon-fixed matrix.
limitations: This is a standalone experiment, not production viewer integration or a performance benchmark.
The diagnostic shader uses a manual diffuse term; it does not reproduce physical irradiance, Earthshine, terrain cast shadows, atmospheric effects or occultation.
The anchor height is the nearest central source pixel, not a separately surveyed height at the exact anchor.
Local Sun direction is computed at one anchor and held constant over the block.
Frame registration to live globe terrain remains unverified.
